maddeler.e: إنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَإنَّا إلَيْهِ راجِعُون • (ʔinnā lillāhi waʔinnā ʔilayhi rājiʕūn)
maddeler.t: Literally, “We belong to God and to him we shall return”. From Quran 2:156.
s: “We belong to God and to him we shall return”
Literally, “We belong to God and to him we shall return”
g: Said in response to the news of someone’s death or as an expression of condolence; less often it may also be said for any other sort of negative occurrence.
ds: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّا اِلَیْهِ رَاجِعُون
innā lillāh-i wa innā ilayh-i rāji'ūn
